item_short_desc: Wear your dog tags with pride and security with Rothco's Dog Tag Chain 2 Piece set. This set includes a longer 24 inch chain and a shorter 4.5 inch chain for versatility and convenience. Please note, the pictured tag is not included. This item is for the chains only. The chains are made from high-quality, durable stainless steel, ensuring they withstand everyday wear and tear while maintaining their sleek appearance. Our Dog Tag Chains offer a secure way to display your dog tags, making them ideal for both daily use and special occasions.
